metrics.label: Versions recorded in plugins/gs-superadmin/CHANGELOG.md
metrics.note: more than this repo's tags: the changelog may predate its history

metrics.label: Lines of JavaScript/TypeScript, excluding tests
metrics.command: git -C Admin_CLI_Explore grep -I -c '' 188ffc4 -- '*.mjs' '*.cjs' '*.js' '*.ts' '*.tsx' | awk -F: '$2 !~ "(^|/)(tests?|__tests__)/|\\.test\\.[a-z]+$|_test\\.[a-z]+$|(^|/)test_[^/]*\\.py$|(^|/)test-[^/]*\\.(mjs|js|sh)$" {s+=$NF} END {print s+0}'

metrics.label: Lines of JavaScript/TypeScript in test files
metrics.command: git -C Admin_CLI_Explore grep -I -c '' 188ffc4 -- '*.mjs' '*.cjs' '*.js' '*.ts' '*.tsx' | awk -F: '$2 ~ "(^|/)(tests?|__tests__)/|\\.test\\.[a-z]+$|_test\\.[a-z]+$|(^|/)test_[^/]*\\.py$|(^|/)test-[^/]*\\.(mjs|js|sh)$" {s+=$NF} END {print s+0}'

metrics.label: Lines of Markdown (docs, skills, ledgers)
metrics.command: git -C Admin_CLI_Explore grep -I -c '' 188ffc4 -- '*.md' | awk -F: '{s+=$NF} END {print s+0}'

metrics.label: Commit authors other than the owner (count only)
metrics.command: git -C Admin_CLI_Explore log --format=%aN 188ffc4 | sort -u | grep -vixF -e 'bradleydb' -e 'bradley' | wc -l

metrics.label: dev-loop findings on the bus, live + archive (at origin/dev 4ad79e4: the release strips dev/)
metrics.command: git -C Admin_CLI_Explore show 4ad79e4:dev/FEEDBACK.md 4ad79e4:dev/FEEDBACK-archive.md | grep -oE '^## F-[0-9]+' | sort -u | wc -l

metrics.label: Merged pull requests
metrics.command: gh pr list -R BradleyDB/gs-admin-cli-docs-private-archive --state merged --limit 2000 --json number --jq length

metrics.label: Merged PRs by someone other than the owner (count only)
metrics.command: gh pr list -R BradleyDB/gs-admin-cli-docs-private-archive --state merged --limit 2000 --json author --jq '[.[] | select(.author.login != "BradleyDB")] | length'
